attestors.note: Mirrors chains/solana/programs/decision-relay/src/lib.rs's ATTESTOR_PUBKEYS/ATTESTOR_THRESHOLD consts exactly — decision-relay has no on-chain enumerable attestor list or governance account the way EVM's DecisionRelay.sol does, so unlike the EVM manifest this cannot be verified against a live on-chain read; it is a source-controlled mirror of the deployed program's hardcoded consts, kept in sync by hand whenever the Rust consts are rotated and re-deployed.
